title: report publish gate: a report whose runtimeFilter names a field the dataset's object lacks publishes 200 and renders "Dataset query failed", where the same key on a dashboard widget filter is refused 422
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGDmSYVyFomEEAdU3

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named landing point and a reproduction (reach: `PUT /api/v1/meta/report/NAME?mode=draft&package=PKG` and `POST /api/v1/meta/report/NAME/publish`; reproduced on two boots, twice on the second, with a dashboard control refused each time).
Business reason: an author publishes a report with a fixed filter whose key is misspelled or names a field that was removed. The publish says success, and every reader who opens the report gets an error panel instead of numbers. The dashboard gate already refuses the identical key at publish (`widget-filter-field-unknown`, which its own source calls a gate "because an empty tile is indistinguishable from a healthy team"), so a report is the one consumer of the same dataset query that ships it broken.
Reader who acts: `domain:server`, the author-time rules in `packages/lint/src` that the publish gate runs (`validate-widget-bindings.ts` holds the widget twin; no rule reads a report's `runtimeFilter` keys).
Dedupe (open and closed): `runtimeFilter` 64 hits, `report runtimeFilter publish` 47, `widget-filter-field-unknown` 197 (run records), `report filter field unknown publish 422` 231. Nearest: #28257 (closed, the dataset draft preview serving an unknown runtimeFilter field) and #29156 (closed, a misplaced runtimeFilter on the query door). Neither covers the report publish gate.

QA-source: #29893 · studio-authoring.report-authoring-options · observed beside the clauses

## What happens

Measured at framework `589049b0` (main, 2026-11-03) on stock showcase boots, as admin, in a runtime package `P`.

1. Publish an object `orch_item` (fields `name`, `status` text, `hours` number) and a dataset `orch_ds2` over it (dimension `status`, measure `hours_sum` = sum of `hours`) through `POST /api/v1/packages/P/publish-drafts`.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/report/orch_r5?mode=draft&package=P` `{"name":"orch_r5","label":"Bad","type":"summary","dataset":"orch_ds2","values":["hours_sum"],"rows":["status"],"runtimeFilter":{"no_such_field":"x"}}` → 200.
3. `POST /api/v1/meta/report/orch_r5/publish?package=P` `{}` → **200** "Published draft — type=report, name=orch_r5"; the live read serves `_diagnostics: {valid: true}`.
4. Open `/_console/apps/P/report/orch_r5`: a `role="alert"` panel reads "Dataset query failed: 400 Bad Request — Filter member no_such_field …".

**Expected:** step 3 refuses `422 INVALID_METADATA` naming `reports[0].runtimeFilter.no_such_field`, as the dashboard twin does.

**Control (same boot, same dataset):** `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/orch_d5?mode=draft&package=P` `{"name":"orch_d5","label":"Bad","widgets":[{"id":"w1","type":"metric","title":"T","dataset":"orch_ds2","values":["hours_sum"],"filter":{"no_such_field":"x"}}]}` → 200, then `POST /api/v1/meta/dashboard/orch_d5/publish?package=P` → **422** `widget-filter-field-unknown` at `dashboards[0].widgets[0].filter.no_such_field`.

## Also measured beside it (same family, not separately carded)

A dashboard widget bound to a dataset of **another** package (`showcase_task_metrics`, over `showcase_task`) with `filter: {no_such_field: 'x'}` publishes 200 from a runtime package (twice), so `widget-filter-field-unknown` is silent when the dataset's object is not in the authoring package's graph. Whoever fixes the report half should check that this is intended.
